_about: Hallucination eval scenarios for ./scripts/eval-run (2026-09-27). Each scenario is one conversation, played through the eval twin from a fresh reset; 'turns' are the requester's messages in order. Never include a bare yes/confirm: the runner refuses it, so nothing can be booked. 'expect' keys are scored only when the reply is a booking summary, except mustAsk/a1/headsUp which apply to any reply.
